verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Stripe documents an official CLI at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli, so the platform underlying the crypto products ships one. The evidence is only a single existence check, with no detail on what the CLI does for crypto or stablecoin workflows. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands covering crypto/stablecoin resources (e.g., onramp sessions, stablecoin payouts), AI-native or agent-oriented CLI usage guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
